campaign.title: 📚 Become a Sundaram Store Retail Partner!
campaign.body:
Hi Ramesh! 🙏

Sundaram Store is expanding its retail network. Become an official partner and enjoy:

✅ Wholesale pricing on stationery
✅ New school season schemes
✅ AI-powered ordering support

Tap Register Now below!

submitted.title: Application Received
submitted.body:
Dear Ramesh Patel,

Thank you for submitting your application to become a Retail Partner of Sundaram Store.

Our team will review your details and get back to you shortly. You will be automatically notified on this channel upon successful registration.

welcome.title: 🎉 Welcome to Sundaram Store Retailer Network!
welcome.body:
Congratulations Ramesh Patel! 🎉

Your store Ganesh General Stores is now an approved Sundaram Store Retail Partner.

Tap Open Menu below to access your self-service dashboard.

campaign.title: 📖 Back to School Offer
campaign.body:
Stock up for the new school season! 📚

Special discounts on notebooks, drawing books, and stationery sets. Orders above ₹25,000 get extra 5% off + free delivery.

Limited period offer!

scheme.title: 💰 Current Scheme — Notebook Range
scheme.body:
Buy 50 pcs A4 Spiral Books → Get 10 pcs FREE + ₹1,000 ZoPs credited to your account.

Valid till 31 Dec 2026.

aiTyping.body: Scheme query detected, ZoAi is composing a response...

aiResponse.title: ZoAi Scheme Explanation
aiResponse.body: Bhai, is scheme mein aapko har 50 A4 Spiral Books par 10 FREE mil rahe hain. Plus ₹1,000 ZoPoints jo next order mein discount ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scheme 31 Dec 2026 tak valid hai. Kya aap order dena chahenge? 😊
